```yaml
name: Deploy and Version

on:
  push:
    branches:
      - main

jobs:
  deploy:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest

    steps:
    - name: Checkout code
      uses: actions/checkout@v3

    - name: Set up Node.js
      uses: actions/setup-node@v3
      with:
        node-version: '16'

    - name: Install dependencies
      run: npm install

    - name: Increment version
      id: increment_version
      run: |
        VERSION_FILE=_includes/VERSION.txt
        CURRENT_VERSION=$(cat $VERSION_FILE)
        NEW_VERSION=$((CURRENT_VERSION + 1))
        echo "::set-output name=NEW_VERSION::$NEW_VERSION"
        echo "$NEW_VERSION" > $VERSION_FILE

    - name: Commit version change
      uses: stefanzweifel/git-auto-commit-action@v4
      with:
        commit_message: chore: bump version to ${{ steps.increment_version.outputs.NEW_VERSION }}
        branch: main
        file_pattern: '_includes/VERSION.txt'
        tag_name: v${{ steps.increment_version.outputs.NEW_VERSION }}

    - name: Build Jekyll site
      run: jekyll build --destination ./_site

    - name: Deploy to GitHub Pages
      uses: JamesIves/github-pages-deploy-action@v4
      with:
        github_token: ${{ secrets.GITHUB_TOKEN }}
        publish_dir: ./_site
        tag: v${{ steps.increment_version.outputs.NEW_VERSION }}
```
